_comment: Which of mxm-fx-convolution's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
Mix fills the existing fx.reverb role: it is how much reverberant response is in what you hear.
Pre-delay and the wet shaping controls remain automatable but unmapped. They shape a response
